\"Save project\" keeps an editable .pixa file inside Pixa so you can carry on later. It does not appear in your gallery.\n\n\"Export image\" creates a final picture (PNG, JPG...) that does appear in your gallery.
Deleted projects are kept for 30 days
Delete every project in the trash?

Not enough memory for that size
Draw roughly along the edge; the line snaps to the contour when you lift your finger.
Tap to add points. Tap the first point or double-tap to close.
Tap the object, or draw around it. More taps refine it; use Remove to exclude areas.
Automatic background removal is not available on this device
Tap the color you want to remove
Drag a corner to distort in perspective
Reflects half of the image over the other half, around the chosen edge
Repeats a circular wedge as many times as segments you set, like a real kaleidoscope. A preview shows as you move the slider.
No Google Fonts API key configured
Couldn\'t load the font list, check your connection
Scroll down to see more fonts
Offline: a system font is used
Use two fingers to move the photo inside the letters
Draw a line and the text will follow it
Couldn\'t load images, check your connection
Drag on the canvas to draw the shape
Enter some content for the code
That content is too long for a QR code
Tap to pick the clone source
Two-finger tap: undo. Three fingers: redo
These layouts only imitate the look of well-known platforms. Do not use them to impersonate anyone or to pass fake content off as real.
Fill in the name and the post text
Could not write to the chosen folder
Side of the toolbar and the layers button
When another app sends a photo to Pixa, start in the Crop panel
Re-fit image when opening or closing panels
That file is not a valid Pixa backup
Open a photo or start a blank canvas and work with layers, text, shapes and filters.
A project stays editable inside Pixa. An exported image goes to your gallery.
Pinch to zoom and drag with two fingers to pan. The hand button next to the zoom makes one finger move the canvas. Tap outside the canvas to deselect, and hold an element for 1 second to delete it.
Collage and comics, memes, social posts, stitched photos and batch editing live in the Create section.
No app can open this link
Allow notifications to see batch progress
Take a photo and edit it
Tap a colour to remove it
The backup includes settings, presets, palettes, watermarks and imported fonts. Your projects are not included.
Drag a slider to preview the change and tap Apply to bake it into the layer. Hold the canvas to compare with the original.
Pick a category, tap a look to preview it and set its strength. Import .cube LUTs in the LUTs tab. Turn on the curtain to compare before / after.
Creative effects in groups: classic, lens and light, art, weather and sky. Each has its own options; use the dice to get another random layout.
Precise colour control: curves per channel, levels, hue and saturation by colour range, and colour replacement.
Drag the frame corners, pick a ratio, or straighten the photo by a few degrees.
Move, scale, rotate, flip, skew or distort the selected layer. The numeric fields are exact.
Image size changes the pixels. Canvas size only changes the area, keeping the layers where they are.
Pick an area to work on. New, add, subtract and intersect decide how each new selection combines with the current one.
Remove the background automatically, by colour, or fix the edges by hand with the restore and erase brushes.
Text layers stay editable until you rasterise them. Tap a layer to edit its words again at any time.
Choose brush, size, hardness and opacity. Each stroke becomes part of the active drawing layer.
Shapes stay vector: you can change their size, colour and corners afterwards without losing quality.
The code is regenerated whenever you change its content, so you can keep editing it later.
Clone stamp copies pixels from one place to another. First tap sets the source, then paint.
Hide what you do not want to show: paint over an area or drag a box, with pixelate or blur.
Faces are detected on the device. Pick which ones to cover and how; each cover becomes an editable layer.
Save your signature or logo as a preset and place it on any image, once or tiled.
Decorative borders drawn over the finished image. They do not change the layers.
Exact position and size of the selected layer, plus alignment and distribution.
Every step you take is listed here. Tap any step to jump straight back to it.
Export writes a flat image to your gallery. To keep layers editable, save the project instead.
Dimensions, file size and EXIF data of the image you opened.
The frame wraps the selected layer at its own size, not the whole canvas
This tool paints pixels, so it needs an image layer. Select one, or rasterize the current layer from the layers menu.
\"%1$s\" is not an image layer, so its pixels cannot be edited yet. Rasterizing turns it into an image: text and shapes stop being editable, though you can still undo.
Tap to add a point, drag to move it, double tap to reset
Source set: paint where you want to cover
Paint or drag over what you want to hide
On-device super-resolution model (about 8 MB, downloaded the first time). There is no size limit, but big photos can take several minutes. You can cancel at any time.
AI task failed (not enough memory, or the model could not be loaded)
No LUTs yet. Import a .cube file to use professional looks.
You have no saved presets yet. Save one from Adjust.
Move the divider to compare with the original
Scales layers to fill the new size; otherwise only the canvas changes
Doubles width and height of the whole canvas
You have a preview that has not been applied yet. If you leave now it will be lost.
Ask before closing a panel that has a pending preview
Before / after curtain on by default
Turns the curtain on every time you open Adjust, Filters or Effects
Tools that use AI models running on your device. Each card shows how much it downloads; before starting you see the estimated time, and you can cancel at any time.
Everything runs on your device. Models are downloaded the first time and can be deleted from the manager below.
Cleans grain and noise from real photos
Restores detail in blurry or low quality faces
Adds color to black and white photos
Blurs the background using a depth map
Adds haze that grows with distance
Tap an object on the image and it gets selected
Fills the selection with what should be behind it
Reads the text that appears in the image
Crops and straightens a paper with the camera
Text recognition is not available yet (it may need a connection the first time)
The scanner could not be started
Select something first: use Select by tap or the Selection tools
Tap the object on the image. Add more taps to refine, or switch to Remove to exclude areas.
The image changed; analyze it again
The time depends on your connection (measured after the first download)
It is measured the first time on this device; you will see the remaining time live
You can cancel at any time.
Could not download the model. Check your connection.
Downloaded models take space on your device. Delete the ones you do not use; they are downloaded again when needed.
See the size of each model, download or delete them
Removes the background with the model you choose, with live preview and fine controls
First analyze the image with the chosen model; then you tune the result live and press Apply.
Remove the subject and keep the background
Fast and with no download of its own. Good for people and clear objects in normal photos.
Made for portraits and selfies: tells hair, skin and clothes apart. Light model.
Very light general cutout at low internal resolution. Best for quick drafts.
Fast general cutout with a good quality for its size. Objects and people.
General cutout, more precise than Silueta on complex shapes.
The most versatile: products, animals and people with clean edges. Recommended for general use.
Portraits with fine hair: real matting with semi-transparent edges. People only.
Very good general quality on products, people and busy backgrounds. BRIA license: non-commercial use only.
Quadruples width and height: best quality, accelerated by the GPU
The result would be too large (max about 48 megapixels). Crop or reduce the image first.
Straightens, fixes converging lines and lens distortion. Works best with buildings, horizons and documents; adjust by hand if needed.
No clear straight lines found; adjust by hand
Draw over an object and it is detected and removed
Paint over the object. It is removed when you lift your finger.
Detect the object inside the stroke
Mark a rough zone and the object found inside is removed. Turn off to erase exactly what you paint.
Detects the object inside the selected zone and removes it
No object detected in that zone. Mark it tighter around the object, or turn off detection to erase exactly what you paint.
Mark small details (moles, spots, wires...) with points, strokes or shapes and fill them from their surroundings
Mark what you want to remove: tap for points, drag for strokes, or pick a shape. Then press Apply. Nothing is detected: exactly what you mark is filled.
The marks are outside the image layer
Cleans noise, restores faces and optionally colors and upscales an old photo in one go
Pick the steps. They run in order: noise, faces, color and upscale.
Only for black and white photos
Move the magnifier away from the finger
It rests in the chosen corner and jumps to another only when the finger gets close. Off: always fixed in that corner.
With the white accent, the header logo cycles vivid colors (never white or gray)
If you go back now, the changes you made will be lost.
Add photos to start your collage
Tap a slot to select it. Drag to frame, pinch to zoom, long-press and drag onto another slot to swap photos.
You have unfinished work in %1$s. Do you want to recover it?
Select a gradient layer to edit it.
Edit the gradient layer: type, preset, the color of each stop (with transparency), where each stop sits and the angle. Opacity and blend mode are changed from the layers manager.
Select a text, shape or other non-image layer to rasterize it.
Stickers are not available: the Klipy API key is missing.
Select a speech bubble layer to edit it.
No faces found: added a single bubble
Move, rotate and resize the bubble with your fingers like any layer. Here you change its text, type, font, colors, outline and where the tail points. Double-tap it on the canvas to edit it again.
Tap a bubble to select it. Drag to move it, pinch to resize it and drag the round handle to aim its tail. Slots work as in a collage.

Image, text, shape, QR, emoji, gradient and speech bubble are all layers. Use the quick or the full manager (it minimizes and the canvas adapts), duplicate, rasterize and add layer styles: shadow, glow and outline.
Rectangle, ellipse, free, polygonal and magnetic lasso, magic wand and select by color. The magnifier helps you refine, and you can duplicate a selection into a new layer.
Over 100 ready-made styles, 20 textures such as gold or galaxy, your own fonts, curved text, text on a path and photos inside the letters.
Brushes with symmetry, vector shapes that stay selected after drawing, QR codes and editable gradients with color, transparency and 6 types.
Add speech bubbles that point at faces by themselves, drag the tail and edit font, margins and shape. Find stickers and stock photos from the + button.
80 filters and 50 effects with thumbnails and live preview. Import LUTs, adjust curves, levels and color by hue. The curtain compares before and after.
Its own section with 9 AI methods. Analyze, refine the edge and the hair with live preview and apply with the check in the header.
Select objects with a tap, erase what you don\'t want with the magic eraser, upscale x4, reduce noise, enhance faces, colorize and restore old photos.
Portrait blur and depth fog, copy the text out of an image and scan documents. Everything runs on your device and each model is downloaded only once.
Over 120 layouts, a comic effect for your photos and a comic mode on an A4 sheet with speech bubbles and face detection.
Autosave and recovery protect the editor and every creator. When leaving, choose to save, export or discard, and deleted projects wait 30 days in the trash.
Choose how the view adapts when opening panels, set up the magnifier, the hand and the guides, and change language or theme in Settings. Every panel has its own help.
If you turn it off, your own LUTs are deleted straight away.
